For those, give the name, the rate, the track count, and how far the rate is above that average. Don't round anything. queries:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name,
         CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM rates r, avg_rate a
WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate;
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS Rate,
         COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(Rate) AS AvgRate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.Rate, r.TrackCount, r.Rate - o.AvgRate AS AboveAverage
FROM rates r
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.Rate > o.AvgRate;
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name,
         CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM rates r, avg_rate a
WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId,
         m.Name,
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Bytes END) AS REAL)
           / SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name,
       rate,
       track_count,
       rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS rate_above_average
FROM r
WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r);
